DDL	CREATE TABLE table_with_comment (a STRING, b INT, c STRING, d STRING) USING parquet COMMENT 'added'
READ	DESC FORMATTED table_with_comment
DDL	ALTER TABLE table_with_comment SET TBLPROPERTIES("comment"= "modified comment", "type"= "parquet")
READ	DESC FORMATTED table_with_comment
DDL	DROP TABLE table_with_comment
DDL	CREATE TABLE table_comment (a STRING, b INT) USING parquet
READ	DESC FORMATTED table_comment
DDL	ALTER TABLE table_comment SET TBLPROPERTIES(comment = "added comment")
READ	DESC formatted table_comment
DDL	ALTER TABLE table_comment UNSET TBLPROPERTIES IF EXISTS ('comment')
READ	DESC FORMATTED table_comment
DDL	DROP TABLE table_comment
